text:
billing-amy: FYI bank sent a CHARGEBACK on acct acct_9382 for $8,720 — cardholder marked transaction as 'unauthorized' for INV-2029-04.
payments-sam: Ugh. Do we have the full payment trace and signed invoice? link: https://redwood.internal/payments/invoices/INV-2029-04
chargeback-bot: Automated notice — Case CBK-2029-1172 created with bank. Deadline to submit evidence: 7 days. Docs required: invoice, delivery proof, signed SOW, communications.
finance-ryan: Pulling SOW and CSM thread. Also need auth code and AVS response from payment gateway. Can payments run `curl` to fetch gateway logs?
payments-sam: yes, running now. snippet:
```
curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $GATE_KEY" "https://gateway.pay/transactions/tx_9e8f/logs"
```
payments-sam: Gateway returned auth_code=AUTH123, AVS=M, amount=8720.00
ops-jen: Customer (AcmeEdu Corp) is disputing seat overage — they claim we billed for 120 seats but their contract was 100. attaching billing CSV excerpt.
billing-amy: Attached invoice shows 120 seats billed. CSM note: customer requested 20 extra seats on 2029-02-14 via support ticket #4529 but no signed amendment on file.
cfo-olivia: What's our exposure if bank sides with cardholder? do we automatically provision hold on future invoices for this account?
legal-noah: Don't auto-refund. We should compile evidence packet and contest. Need copy of signed SOW, support ticket transcript, usage logs (timestamps), and IP/geo info at time of transactions. Also merchant descriptor proof.
finance-ryan: I'll assemble evidence. @payments-sam can you export usage logs for window 2029-02-10..2029-02-16 and include request IDs? Prefer CSV/MD5 checksum.
payments-sam: exporting now, will post in this thread when done. :hourglass_flowing_sand:
billing-amy: Also flag for potential billing process gap — we shouldn't have allowed seat bump without signed amendment. tagging @ops-jen for follow-up.
ops-jen: Ack, will open a ticket to enforce amendment requirement in billing flow.
payments-sam: Evidence uploaded to secure bucket: s3://redwood-evidence/CBK-2029-1172/ — shared with legal/finance only.
legal-noah: Received. I'll draft the contest letter to the issuer. Schedule: submit by CBK deadline (7 days).
cfo-olivia: Thanks team. Keep updates here. If contest fails we need write-off approval route — I'll prepare a capex vs write-off analysis.
billing-amy: Noted. tagging @cfo-olivia when contest outcome known. :thumbsup:
